_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); automaker signals, the early era

pit_profile.why: Ford Motor Company: 'We are a global company based in Dearborn, Michigan.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Industry sales volume, particularly in the United States, Europe, or China, can be volatile and could decline if there is a financial crisis, recession, or significant geopolitical event.' and 'Ford’s results are dependent on sales of larger, more profitable vehicles, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2018 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an automaker on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on the shift away from trucks and SUVs stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Ford Motor Company: 'We are a global company based in Dearborn, Michigan.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Industry sales volume, particularly in the United States, Europe, or China, can be volatile and could decline if there is a financial crisis, recession, or significant geopolitical event.' and 'Ford’s results are dependent on sales of larger, more profitable vehicles, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2018 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an automaker on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on the shift away from trucks and SUVs stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.28x; +34% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.88; conservative 2yr -2%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -28.0%/yr (worst year FY09-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-6.0%/yr (Q1 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +71.7%/yr (FY09-FY18 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +1128.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY18); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: F (retrospective, 2019-07-12) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.28x (61.9% downside to Bear $4 / +224.1% upside to Bull $34) | Adj composite 1.93 vs market 1.05: gap +0.88 [UNDERVALUED] | +34% above the EPP floor $8 (6x FY19E $1.30) | Conservative 2-yr case: -1.5% total (-0.7%/yr) | At 8.1x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $14 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; wholesale units -14.3% in Q1 2019, forward revenues -3.9% (no Q2 2019 revenue guide, Q1 2019 revenue as reported); no disruption theme is live for an automaker on this date.
